title: Blindside
problem: Damage = caster Speed × Small (90%), with the target's Defense ignored. There is no Intelligence part. The text says nothing about Speed, so it reads as Intelligence.
notes: Community claim: Damage is 100% Speed-based (90% Speed + 10% casting stat). Evidence: bc_SpellDamage case L1466-L1467 @0x141603e60 (Small tier, Defense set to 0); stat audit code_stat = SPD. Fix sketch: T: add "based on the caster's Speed". Or S: point the case at the Int local ([rsp+0xb7d8]) instead of Speed (0xb7f8) Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Damage scales off Speed. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Target takes a small amount of damage". Fix: S: bc_SpellDamage L1466 Blindside case, lea rcx,[rsp+0xb7f8] (caster Speed) @0x141604031 -> [rsp+0xb7d8] (the casting-stat local 64 other Small cases use): byte @0x141604035 f8 -> d8. vs bugged: depends on the caster (Speed builds weaker, Intelligence builds stronger). 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0138 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: The target takes a small amount of damage that ignores its Defense.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the damage was based on the caster's Speed.
release_notes.fix: Now it is based on the caster's Intelligence, like other spells.
